title: Welcome to the Jungle Jobs Scraper input

searchUrls.title: Welcome to the Jungle search URLs
searchUrls.description: Job search pages copied from welcometothejungle.com/en/jobs (or /fr/jobs) with any filters set on the site: country, contract, remote, profession, sector... Each URL is one search.

queries.title: Keywords
queries.description: Or build searches here. One search per keyword, e.g. data engineer, product manager, stage marketing. Leave empty with filters set to get every job matching the filters.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Two-letter country codes, e.g. FR, US, GB, DE, ES. Empty means all.

cities.title: Cities
cities.description: City names as the site writes them, e.g. Paris, Lyon, London, New York. Empty means all.

contractTypes.title: Contract
contractTypes.description: Any of these. Empty means all.

remote.title: Remote policy
remote.description: Any of these. Empty means all.

languages.title: Job ad language
languages.description: Language the ad is written in, e.g. en, fr, de, es. Empty means all.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within (days)
postedWithinDays.description: Only jobs published in the last this many days. Empty means any time.

includeDetails.title: Full description, skills and apply link
includeDetails.description: Reads each job for its full description, requirements, hiring process, skills, tools, street address, start date and the apply link (often the company's ATS). $0.003 per job instead of $0.002.

maxItemsPerSearch.title: Max jobs per search
maxItemsPerSearch.description: Newest first. Searches with more than 1,000 results are split by date, so a broad search can return tens of thousands.
